text: Who was the first person to refer to their video as a Let's Play?\n🗨️ Discussion\n Most sources I can find claim that slowbeef was the first person to make a video in the format that we now use to describe a Let's Play, video footage of a game with player commentary, opinions, and reactions played over it. His video was uploaded on Jan 19, 2007. What I'm looking for is the first documented instance of someone calling their game a Let's Play. Wikipedia states that the term itself was coined on the SomethingAwful forums in 2007, although the exact origin is unclear. Through my own research I've found the video Let's Play La-Mulana 001: Surface by DeceasedCrab, uploaded on March 28, 2007. As far as I've found, this is the first instance of someone titling their video as a Let's Play. I may be wrong, but I can't find anything earlier than that. I'm curious what you all think, if anyone can find something earlier than that please share!
